about.headline: Fullstack Engineering & Applied AI
about.summary: Experienced Fullstack Developer focused on AI integration and scalable web applications. 4+ years building reliable web platforms, ML/DL pipelines (PyTorch, TensorFlow), Explainable AI (SHAP, LIME), modular IAM/SSO microservices, type-safe API gateways (tRPC, GraphQL), and Next.js/React frontends. Harvard CS50x certified with a strong foundation in clean architecture.
